in_marathi.name: Dhrutika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhrutika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhruti means 'firm, steadfast'. The name Dhrutika is derived from this root, implying a strong and unwavering spirit. In Hindu mythology, Dhrutarashtra, the blind king, was a symbol of steadfastness and unwavering duty.
